rationale: P identifies the ego vehicle’s braking behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. This behaviour is directly established by safety goal SG-3 and hazard H-3’s sudden-stop event without an obstacle ahead. The declared scope matches H-3’s operational situation. P does not extend the phenomenon to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism-specific timing.
determining_elements: “Braking behaviour of the ego vehicle” is itself the behaviour required by the Evaluation Target, rather than merely a mechanism affecting its evaluation.
“Whether braking occurs unintentionally in the absence of a visible obstacle or vehicle ahead” is supported by H-3 and SG-3.
The scope—straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, in good weather, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead—matches the supplied hazard.
No observation or control mechanisms, or their timing constraints, are incorporated into P.
